samples.summary: No test asserts that merges the paste DROPS are removed from the store (only the created one is checked for persistence)
samples.evidence: `applyPasteMerges` calls `await this.store.deleteMerge(...)` alongside the in-memory `this.merges.delete(...)` (sheet.ts ~2560). Every new drop test — 'should drop a cut merged block at the source' (merge.test.ts:379-401), 'should drop a destination block the paste fully covers' (:403-424), 'should not refuse a cut whose destination clips its own block' (:526-556) — asserts only `sheet.getMerges()` (the in-memory map). The one store assertion added, 'should persist the pasted merge to the store' (:355-383), checks `store.getMerges().get('A3')` for a CREATED merge only. If `store.deleteMerge` were dropped or given the wrong anchor, the whole suite would still be green while the stale merge reappears from the store on reload — a persistent, user-visible layout corruption.
searchedFor: read merge.test.ts new copy-paste describe block

samples.summary: The removal of `clearCopyBuffer()` from the two view paste handlers has no test at the view layer
samples.evidence: The diff deletes `this.sheet!.clearCopyBuffer()` (view/worksheet.ts) and `this.sheet.clearCopyBuffer()` (view/spreadsheet.ts) after `paste()`. The only view-layer paste coverage is `test/view/worksheet-keymap.test.ts:22,59`, where `paste` is a `vi.fn()` on a mocked sheet and the buffer lifecycle is not observed at all. The new model tests ('should propagate merges on a second paste from the same copy', 'should keep the copy buffer when a paste is refused') exercise `Sheet.paste` directly, so re-introducing a `clearCopyBuffer()` call in either view handler would regress repeat/refused paste with a fully green suite.

samples.summary: `crossesFreezePane`'s frozen-COLUMN branch is untested on every path that uses it (paste refusal, move refusal, canMergeSelection)
samples.evidence: `crossesFreezePane` checks rows and columns; the new tests only use `setFreezePane(2, 0)` (rows) — merge.test.ts:623 for 'merge-paste-frozen' and :692 for 'merge-move-frozen'. The refactored `canMergeSelection` frozen guard (sheet.ts:4678) has no test at all: the only `canMergeSelection` test in the repo is pivot-protection.test.ts:132 ('returns false on pivot sheets'). A broken column branch (e.g. off-by-one on `<=`) would ship undetected.

samples.summary: The spill-handling and `unblockedAnchors` branches of `clearCellsUnderMerge` are untested on the new paste path
samples.evidence: `applyPasteMerges` -> `clearCellsUnderMerge` handles spill anchors (deleting ghosts), `spillBlocked` cells, and reports freed blockers via `unblockedAnchors`, which `paste` then feeds into `calculate` (sheet.ts:2340-2351 — a new condition `changedSrefs.size > 0 || unblockedAnchors.size > 0` plus new dependantsMap seeding). No test in packages/sheets/test combines spill with merge or with paste: `grep spillAnchor|spillBlocked` in test/ matches only worksheet-grid, data-validation, formatting and style-mutation tests, none involving merges or paste. The only stale-data test is 'should hide no stale data under a pasted merge' (merge.test.ts:~470), which uses a plain literal. Orphaned ghost cells or a spill that never re-attempts would ship silently.

samples.evidence: `snapshotMergesIn` filters copied merges with `isRangeInRange(m.range, range)` so a block the copy range only clips is excluded. Nothing asserts that a programmatic copy of a clipping range omits the partial block (and therefore does not recreate a mangled block at the destination).

verdict.reason: The absence claim checks out. applyPasteMerges performs two independent deletions (sheet.ts:2538 store.deleteMerge, 2539 this.merges.delete), and MemStore.getMerges() returns a defensive copy (memory.ts:594-596) while Sheet.getMerges() returns the sheet's own map (sheet.ts:811-813), so in-memory assertions cannot observe the store call. All paste-drop tests assert only sheet.getMerges() (merge.test.ts:400-402, :424, :451, :548-554). The one paste-path store assertion (merge.test.ts:382-383) checks a CREATED merge via store.setMerge. The only store-delete assertion in the file (merge.test.ts:160-163, stored.has('A1') === false) exercises the MOVE call site at sheet.ts:2771, not applyPasteMerges. I searched repo-wide: getMerges appears in tests only in cli/test/sheets-view.test.ts (mocks), src/store/__tests__/memory-load.test.ts:110, and merge.test.ts; no test calls loadMerges() after a paste (only test/helpers/concurrency-driver.ts:18, whose op set has no paste/cut); clipboard.test.ts has no merge/store-merge assertions; no e2e coverage exists. Dropping or mis-anchoring store.deleteMerge in the paste path would leave the suite fully green while a stale merge reappears on reload — a durable, user-visible layout/data-hiding defect, so the gap is blocking under the test-adequacy rubric.
